name: BitPay

evidence.crypto: F02: crypto payment processor; C01: invoices accept BTC, ETH, USDC and others
evidence.billing: F14: subscription records and API schedules send recurring invoices; buyer pays each one
evidence.links: F16: shareable invoice URL and dashboard payment buttons, no code needed

line: Crypto checkout that can settle to a bank account or wallet.

free.text: No monthly fee stated; transaction fees apply

cells.countries: US and Canada; new UK and EEA onboarding paused
cells.payout: Business-day settlement; bank arrival 1–2 business days

fee.math: The published fee for crypto payments, for sellers under $500,000 a month in volume. Example: 2% of $100, plus $0.25, is $2.25.
New sign-ups from the UK are paused right now.
New sign-ups from the European Economic Area (EEA) are paused right now.
The published crypto fee applies to sellers under $500,000 a month in volume. It isn't published whether sellers in India can sign up.
